svg.title: Commercial Fusion Energy 2026: From Tokamak Assembly to Tritium-Bred Architecture
svg.desc: Blueprint blueprint evolution. titled “Commercial Fusion Energy 2026: From Tokamak Assembly to Tritium-Bred Architecture”. takeaway: Six of nine ITER sector modules now sit in the pit [S4], so the binding constraint has shifted from assembly physics to tritium breeding and neutron-resistant materials [S2].
